Container.Name: Marquee
Container.Overview: Marquee is a self-hosted web app for managing your Plex media posters for Movies, TV Shows, TV Seasons, and Collections. Import every poster from Plex, then refine each one in place by uploading your own art, pasting an image URL, or picking a replacement from an online poster search. Updated posters are sent back to Plex and locked so Plex keeps your choice. Includes a Poster Wall slideshow with a live "now playing" view.
Container.Requires: A reachable Plex Media Server. No token or credentials are set here; you sign in to Plex from within the Marquee web interface.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Marquee web interface

Config.Name: PLEX_SERVER_URL
Config.Description: URL of your Plex Media Server, e.g. http://192.168.X.X:32400

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the config volume (99 = nobody on Unraid)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the config volume (100 = users on Unraid)
